title: Nourishing Creamy French Renkon Lotus Root Gratin
description: A rich and creamy French dish featuring renkon lotus root, perfect for special occasions, with a poached twist and gluten-free friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine the sliced renkon lotus root and enough cold water to cover, then bring to a boil and poach for 10 minutes.
In a skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat, then add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine the heavy cream and shredded gruyere cheese, then stir over low heat until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of poached renkon lotus root, then spoon some of the cheese sauce over the top.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of cheese sauce on top.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh thyme over the top of the gratin, then dot with the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
